args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a gentle healing glow rising around a target: a soft rounded aura of warm white and pale green-gold light, small leaf-shaped light motes and tiny sparkles drifting upward. Restrained version: compact size, fewer particles, small glow core, soft white, pale gold and sky-blue colors, clean readable shape. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster: solid parts (bandage cloth, feathers, pebbles) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing energy parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. Layered composition: a bright core shape, secondary shapes, and small scattered particles. No crosses, no religious symbols, no letters or runes. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no silhouettes, no creatures, no weapons, no text, transparent background.
